title: Libro Install Profile
description: JSON Schema for Libro install-profile manifests. Every manifest under manifests/ MUST validate against this schema.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference (relative or absolute URL). Lets editors validate manifests inline. Not enforced; ignored by the parity validator.

name.description: Profile identifier in kebab-case prefixed `libro-`. Examples: libro-core, libro-govcon.

version.description: Profile version (semver). Bumps when manifest contents change.

spec_version.description: Profile schema version this manifest conforms to. Locked at 1.0.0; bumps when this schema changes.

parent_profile.description: Profile this one extends. `libro-core` is the root and has parent_profile: null. All vertical profiles MUST set parent_profile: 'libro-core'.

audience.description: ICP target for this profile. Drives landing-copy variant selection and starter skill choice.

additive_modules.description: Modules added on top of parent_profile. libro-core lists its full module set here (parent_profile=null). Vertical profiles list ONLY the additions on top of libro-core.

skills.description: Skill names matching skills/<name>/. Each skill must pass the externalization pre-commit hook before merge. Skills that ship with the Claude host platform (rather than with Libro) are declared in host_provided_dependencies instead.

brain_scaffold.description: Brain folder paths to template into the install (e.g., master-brain/CLAUDE.md, master-brain/awareness.md). All entries are operator-generic — populate at install time from the operator profile.

doctrine.description: Doctrine documents shipped with the profile.

runner_components.description: Bash runner pieces this profile contributes (e.g., install.sh, doctor extension). libro-core ships the base runner; verticals can extend.

landing_copy.description: Path (relative to the repo root) to the landing-copy template variant for this profile.

starter_skill_optional.description: Optional first-run skill the buyer can invoke on day 1. Examples: govcon-find-solicitations, content-first-post, ops-first-brief. null for libro-core (no vertical-specific starter).

host_provided_dependencies.description: Skills the profile assumes are present on the Claude host platform (e.g., Claude Code built-ins or platform plugins). Libro does NOT package these — they ship with the host. The doctor surfaces a warning if a host-provided dependency is missing post-install.

excluded_paths.description: Paths explicitly NOT shipped (defense-in-depth alongside the externalization pre-commit hook). Examples: paths that contain operator-internal records, handoffs, or memory storage.

bundle_size_goal.description: Targets used by build-bundle.sh to detect drift. Soft warnings only.
